sources.title: Daniel Sweet's plan for the lab's machines, Phase 3's checklist (docs/lab-machines-plan.md, approved 2026-11-09, PR #27): the lab's own program if it shares one, otherwise a short labelled test program. The moves are Claude Code's choice (2026-11-10)

behavior.name: A test program of joint moves for the ReBeL twin (labelled: not the lab's)
behavior.description: A labelled test program in iRC's XML, written by Claude Code because the lab has shared no program: from the photographed pose, each joint alone out and back, then all six together and home, at 100 % (45 deg/s) and 50 %, Acc 40 %. Not tried on the real arm.

program.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- A test program for the twin igus/rebel6dof02, written by Claude Code for the lab's
     machines plan, Phase 3 (decision 0033). Not the lab's program; not tried on the real
     arm. Angles in degrees, as iRC's (igus's, from the arm straight up). -->
<Program>
<Joint AbortCondition="False" Nr="1" Source="Numerical" velPercent="100" acc="40" smooth="0" a1="0" a2="-21.81" a3="118.82" a4="0" a5="10.46" a6="0" e1="0" e2="0" e3="0" Descr="Start: the photographed pose, the twin's 0 (no motion on the twin)" />
<Joint AbortCondition="False" Nr="2" Source="Numerical" velPercent="100" acc="40" smooth="0" a1="45" a2="-21.81" a3="118.82" a4="0" a5="10.46" a6="0" e1="0" e2="0" e3="0" Descr="Joint 1 alone to +45" />
<Joint AbortCondition="False" Nr="3" Source="Numerical" velPercent="100" acc="40" smooth="0" a1="-45" a2="-21.81" a3="118.82" a4="0" a5="10.46" a6="0" e1="0" e2="0" e3="0" Descr="Joint 1 alone to -45: 90 deg at 45 deg/s" />
<Joint AbortCondition="False" Nr="4" Source="Numerical" velPercent="50" acc="40" smooth="0" a1="0" a2="-21.81" a3="118.82" a4="0" a5="10.46" a6="0" e1="0" e2="0" e3="0" Descr="Joint 1 back to 0 at half speed" />
<Joint AbortCondition="False" Nr="5" Source="Numerical" velPercent="100" acc="40" smooth="0" a1="0" a2="-45" a3="118.82" a4="0" a5="10.46" a6="0" e1="0" e2="0" e3="0" Descr="Joint 2 leans back" />
<Joint AbortCondition="False" Nr="6" Source="Numerical" velPercent="100" acc="40" smooth="0" a1="0" a2="-21.81" a3="118.82" a4="0" a5="10.46" a6="0" e1="0" e2="0" e3="0" Descr="Joint 2 back" />
<Joint AbortCondition="False" Nr="7" Source="Numerical" velPercent="100" acc="40" smooth="0" a1="0" a2="-21.81" a3="90" a4="0" a5="10.46" a6="0" e1="0" e2="0" e3="0" Descr="Joint 3 raises the forearm" />
<Joint AbortCondition="False" Nr="8" Source="Numerical" velPercent="100" acc="40" smooth="0" a1="0" a2="-21.81" a3="118.82" a4="0" a5="10.46" a6="0" e1="0" e2="0" e3="0" Descr="Joint 3 back" />
<Joint AbortCondition="False" Nr="9" Source="Numerical" velPercent="100" acc="40" smooth="0" a1="0" a2="-21.81" a3="118.82" a4="45" a5="10.46" a6="0" e1="0" e2="0" e3="0" Descr="Joint 4 turns the forearm" />
<Joint AbortCondition="False" Nr="10" Source="Numerical" velPercent="100" acc="40" smooth="0" a1="0" a2="-21.81" a3="118.82" a4="0" a5="10.46" a6="0" e1="0" e2="0" e3="0" Descr="Joint 4 back" />
<Joint AbortCondition="False" Nr="11" Source="Numerical" velPercent="100" acc="40" smooth="0" a1="0" a2="-21.81" a3="118.82" a4="0" a5="-30" a6="0" e1="0" e2="0" e3="0" Descr="Joint 5 tilts the hand" />
<Joint AbortCondition="False" Nr="12" Source="Numerical" velPercent="100" acc="40" smooth="0" a1="0" a2="-21.81" a3="118.82" a4="0" a5="10.46" a6="0" e1="0" e2="0" e3="0" Descr="Joint 5 back" />
<Joint AbortCondition="False" Nr="13" Source="Numerical" velPercent="100" acc="40" smooth="0" a1="0" a2="-21.81" a3="118.82" a4="0" a5="10.46" a6="90" e1="0" e2="0" e3="0" Descr="Joint 6 turns the hand" />
<Joint AbortCondition="False" Nr="14" Source="Numerical" velPercent="100" acc="40" smooth="0" a1="0" a2="-21.81" a3="118.82" a4="0" a5="10.46" a6="0" e1="0" e2="0" e3="0" Descr="Joint 6 back" />
<Joint AbortCondition="False" Nr="15" Source="Numerical" velPercent="50" acc="40" smooth="0" a1="30" a2="-35" a3="100" a4="30" a5="-20" a6="60" e1="0" e2="0" e3="0" Descr="All six together at half speed" />
<Joint AbortCondition="False" Nr="16" Source="Numerical" velPercent="100" acc="40" smooth="0" a1="0" a2="-21.81" a3="118.82" a4="0" a5="10.46" a6="0" e1="0" e2="0" e3="0" Descr="All six back to the photographed pose" />
</Program>
